description: Each template's limbs but their armour parts; a limb with no row has zero in every column.

columns.name: enemy
columns.description: the template

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: limb
columns.description: the limb

columns.name: hp
columns.description: the limb's hit points

columns.name: agility_defense_bonus
columns.description: signed; added to the enemy's agility (intelligence for Exorcism and Banish) when an action rolls to hit this limb, then scaled by (100 - the enemy's risk) percent: at 0 risk each point lowers the chance by 1, and a negative value makes the limb easier to hit. It counts for the hit functions agility-difference (attacks, break arts, most enemy abilities), agility-difference-2 (spells) and intelligence-difference; see ASSET_PIPELINE 4.7.1

columns.name: chain_evasion
columns.description: how well the limb evades Ashley's chain abilities (hit_function chain-evasion): they land (255 - value) * 100 / 255 percent of the time, plus her hidden 10, so 0 always lands, 128 lands 59% and 255 lands 10%

columns.name: type_none
columns.description: signed; each point adds 1% to the defense the enemy's own strength (intelligence for spells) gives this limb against hits of this type
